summary: Initializes four engine-wear slots to FLT_MAX, then, only when the engine-wear mode global is 1 or 2, recomputes each slot from a scaled noise value (optionally divided by a race-lap factor when session type is 7 and mode is 2), clamping to the maximum float. Part of the engine wear/failure simulation.

operations.description: Initialize the four engine-wear slots this+0x3D64..0x3D70 to 2139095039 (0x7F800000, FLT_MAX).
Proceed with wear computation only when engine-wear mode dword_7CEA5C is greater than 0 and less than or equal to 2.
EmptyStubWithFlagCheck(2, 0) marks entry into the wear-update path.
Iterate 4 times, one pass per wear slot, writing consecutive float values from this+0x3D64.
When session type dword_7C56A4 == 7 and wear mode dword_7CEA5C == 2, divide the computed wear by flt_8ACF9C.
Clamp the computed wear to the maximum float 3.4028235e38 and store it into the current wear slot, otherwise store the raw value.
EmptyStubWithFlagCheck(1, 0) marks completion of the wear-update path.
Return dword_7CEA5C when the wear path is skipped (mode outside 1..2).
